info.name: Twilio - Accounts A2p Dialing Permissions API

params.name: IsoCode
params.description: The [ISO country code](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2) of the DialingPermissions Country resource to fetch

items.docs: Retrieve voice dialing country permissions identified by the given ISO country code

params.name: IsoCode
params.description: Filter to retrieve the country permissions by specifying the [ISO country code](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2)

params.name: Continent
params.description: Filter to retrieve the country permissions by specifying the continent

params.name: LowRiskNumbersEnabled
params.description: Filter to retrieve the country permissions with dialing to low-risk numbers enabled. Can be: `true` or `false`.

params.name: HighRiskSpecialNumbersEnabled
params.description: Filter to retrieve the country permissions with dialing to high-risk special service numbers enabled. Can be: `true` or `false`

params.name: HighRiskTollfraudNumbersEnabled
params.description: Filter to retrieve the country permissions with dialing to high-risk [toll fraud](https://www.twilio.com/blog/how-to-protect-your-account-from-toll-fraud-with-voice-dialing-geo-permissions-html) numbers enabled. Can be: `true` or `false`.

params.name: PageSize
params.description: How many resources to return in each list page. The default is 50, and the maximum is 1000.

params.name: Page
params.description: The page index. This value is simply for client state.

params.name: PageToken
params.description: The page token. This is provided by the API.

items.docs: Retrieve all voice dialing country permissions for this account
Create a bulk update request to change voice dialing country permissions of one or more countries identified by the corresponding [ISO country code](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2)

params.name: IsoCode
params.description: The [ISO 3166-1 country code](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2) to identify the country permissions from which high-risk special service number prefixes are fetched

params.name: PageSize
params.description: How many resources to return in each list page. The default is 50, and the maximum is 1000.

params.name: Page
params.description: The page index. This value is simply for client state.

params.name: PageToken
params.description: The page token. This is provided by the API.

items.docs: Fetch the high-risk special services prefixes from the country resource corresponding to the [ISO country code](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2)
